content: Before administering simethicone, inform your doctor or pharmacist if your child has any allergies to this medication or other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. Simethicone in this form is typically not used by adults and is unlikely to be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products your child uses, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Note that simethicone may reduce the absorption of thyroid medications, such as levothyroxine. In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms like loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. For less severe cases, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. If your child is on a regular dosing schedule and misses a dose, administer it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with the regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from moisture, heat, and light. Do not freeze it or store it in the bathroom. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your child. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your child’s specific health needs.
